proof_boundary: Explicit low-degree simplicial coboundaries on Fin 5 compose to zero and preserve the displayed curvatures under exact shifts. The ZMod 2 product cocycle is not any displayed 2-coboundary, as detected by the explicit three-term functional. Two supplied integer involutions have commutator -I. Crossed-module identity formulas reduce to reflexivity and do not construct an arbitrary crossed module. There is no identification with Wang-Levin braiding, a path integral, or a unique physical cancellation mechanism.
